jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Job description

Tradebe is a multinational company where innovation meets environmental stewardship. We're on a mission to revolutionize sustainable solutions globally, we are in constant growth!

Therefore, we are thrilled to share our Leadership accelerator program. This program is designed to nurture and accelerate the leadership potential in individuals like you.

We are looking for a Project Manager for our Innovation Committee, and you'll play a crucial role in driving process improvement and innovation. Based initially in Barcelona, you'll later relocate to the UK.

The role
• Coordinate with plants to understand process improvement needs. Propose improvement and optimization projects.
• Search for public funding to develop R+D+it projects.
• State-of-the-art knowledge of new technologies and processes. Contact with technology centers and universities.
• Coordinating internal resources and third parties for the correct execution of the project.
• Ensuring that all projects are... delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
• Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
• Developing project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
• Develop a detailed project plan to track progress.
• Use appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule and costs.
• Report and escalate to management as needed.
• Manage the relationship with all stakeholders.
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.

The person
• Great educational background, preferably in chemical engineering.
• Proven working experience as a project manager in the chemical or waste sector.
• Solid technical background, with experience in R+D+it.
• Good client-facing and internal communication skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.

We offer
• A challenging job in a fast-growing environment.
• A good working climate within a young dynamic team.
• A competitive salary.
• The chance to actively grow within our organization.
• You will work with the newest high-tech equipment on various projects.
• Working in an international company with the possibility to grow.

Do you think this vacancy is for you? Apply now, we want to meet you!

If this offer does not match your expectations, but you would like to develop your career in a company that promotes circular economy and sustainability, register on our Career Page. Don't miss out on new job opportunities!

Tradebe and Tecnoambiente are committed to guaranteeing selection processes based on merit and skills free of any bias based on age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or nationality. We believe in equal opportunities, and we work for it.

Please note Tradebe's Internal Career Opportunities Policy will apply.

EOE/M/F/AA/Veterans/Disabled

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst - Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are Addyou, a new consulting concept where we combine agile selection processes, supported by technology and analysis, but without losing focus on the most important thing, PEOPLE. We are specialized in IT, Digital & Engineer.

We want to meet you!

Our client is a multinational software company with offices in Germany, France and Japan. They are currently opening new offices in Barcelona and we are collaborating with them in the selection of people for the Business Analyst team. It isn´t a data profile

💥💥 Who are they? They are Sollers Consulting, a multinational with more than 700 professionals who work building the digital future for companies in the banking and insurance sector at an international level. They continue to grow, they have chosen Valencia and are looking for people who like challenges and ambitious projects with a high level of technical demand.

👍🏻⚡️ They are a company that places a lot of value on people and that is why they are the center of their culture... You know why? We tell you what you will find when you arrive at Sollers Consulting.

• An onboarding at the headquarters, Warsaw, where you will learn about the history of Sollers Consulting and you will be trained in tools, processes and you will be able to meet your colleagues from Poland.

• You will be assigned a coach who will accompany you during on boarding and afterwards to ensure proper development.

• A personal Budget to continue training.

• A highly qualified team that will allow you to tackle projects with great technical demands.

• Semi-annual evaluations to analyze your performance and promote promotion.

• You will work under the framework of Agile methodology (Scrum) which will allow you to have autonomy and actively participate in the projects.

👋🏻👋🏻 As you can see at Sollers Consulting you have a great journey!

🚀 What will be your responsibilities?
• You will be part of the team that implements IT solutions for financial institutions and you will have to understand the needs of customers to offer the right solutions.
• You will create concepts for implementation in close coordination with the IT team.
• You will define functional requirements and test created solutions.
• You will support B2B sales activities.

🚀 What do we expect from you?
• English & Spanish
• Minimum experience of 2/3 years in core systems implementation projects.
• Analytical thinking and ability to synthesize to present results.
• Ability to learn quickly in a challenging environment.
• Ability to work in a team with different roles.
• Availability to travel regularly.

🚀 What do we offer you?
• It’s permanent positions.
• Personal training budget.
• 25 days of vacation.
• Six-monthly evaluations to analyze promotion possibilities based on results.
• Participation in international projects.
• Work with a mixed model (2 days in the office).
• Salary range depending on experience.
• Attractive remuneration package (SBA, bonus and variable, social benefits

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Overview:

If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!

Flowserve is an American multinational corporation and one of the largest suppliers of industrial and environmental machinery, from pumps and seals to valves, actuation and instrumentation, to energy recovery devices and hydraulic decoking systems, and more, our products help plants overcome the... toughest flow control challenges.

The Project Manager will plan, direct, and ensure the successful outcome of projects utilizing the assigned project teams, as well as standards, practices, and toolsets established within Flowserve. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all project activity is regularly reported to the client and performed as per agreed technical specifications and project terms and conditions.

Responsibilities :
• Demonstrate ownership and accountability for total project execution, performance, and safety (project initiation to project completion) on all assigned projects.
• Drive improved customer relationships through creating a work environment that is free of unfavorable circumstances or perceptions for either party, that meets or exceeds performance expectations of the customer.
• Ensure a "clean order" before commencement of work on an assigned project and utilize the change management system to control the scope of work and associated cost, throughout the life of the project.
• Coordinate activities of all matrix reports (per Project).
• Responsible for managing spending expectations on each assigned Project.
• Communicate to all concerned parties project milestones, status updates, as well as any existing or potential customer escalation issues. Follow the right escalation processes and take overall ownership of all reports.
• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements :
• BS or BA Degree in relevant field (engineering) and 0-5 years relevant experience
• Proficient English skills
• Adaptability, flexibility, and proactivity.
• Excellent presentation, oral and written communication skills, including meeting and workshop facilitation experience
• Team building, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills
• Experience using Microsoft Office.

Nice to have:
• Experience in program/project management.
• Proven experience in risk and change management
• Greenbelt, Blackbelt or Lean training experience preferred
• Rotating equipment experience
• Excellent estimating, scheduling & budgeting skills

What we offer (among other benefits):
• Canteen 100% founded by the company
• Transportation services 100% founded by the company
• Flexible working time: 30 minutes ahead or behind
• Summer timetable (shorter working hours)
• Easy access to the facility with city bus (line 283 from Avenida Americas)
• Easy access to the facility by car: close to M21 motorway junction

Req ID : R-9263

Job Family Group : Engineering

Job Family : EN Engineering

EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co-workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access flowservecareers.com as result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to employment@flowserve.com. In order to quickly respond to your request, please use the words "Accommodation Request" as your subject line of your email. For more information, read the Accessibility Process

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager, Solutions Delivery
jobs_results.description:
About Thunes

Thunes is a global, fast-growing, and innovative Fintech scale-up that uses technology to disrupt and transform the existing financial system.
We have a strong Mission: to create a better global payments network, and a great Purpose: to connect the world to economic opportunities and address systemic inequality when it comes to financial services.
We are proud to power payments for the world’s fastest-growing businesses and work with some of the amazing global brands - from Gig Economy giants such as Uber and Deliveroo and Southeast Asia's super-app Grab, to global Fintech leaders such as PayPal and Remitly.
Our Products help to drastically simplify the Payment integration experience for our customers: with a single, simple connection, businesses and consumers can send payments to – and get paid in – every corner of the world. Instantly.
Thunes is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in London, Barcelona, Paris, Beijing, Shanghai, Miami, Dubai, Nairobi... Manila, Hong Kong and San Francisco!

Context of the role

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to be an integral part of our Solutions Delivery Team.
As part of the Solution Delivery team, this role will bring you great opportunities to work on various projects, collaborating with a diverse range of partners and teams.
The Solution Delivery team is responsible for supporting the integration of partners within the Thunes Cross-Border Payment platform. Processing millions of transactions per month and interconnecting hundreds of partners from all around the world, Thunes is continuously growing its coverage and footprint in the industry. A career with Thunes provides invaluable experience in an exciting and rapidly expanding market and an opportunity to be part of a truly global company with various offices worldwide and a workforce that includes dozens of different nationalities.

Qualities you would find in our Payment Integration Team
• Strong Team Spirit - Ability to learn lots of things and happy to help and each other
• Empowerment - Initiatives to build tools and propose solutions that adds value to the business
• Ownership - End to end ownership of project management in continuous integration from concept to deployment

Responsibilities:

We’re looking for a highly driven, self-motivated, technically hands-on person who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company and for our partners.
In this role, you will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working with different types of partners you must remain agile and always adapt your process and mindset to the partner you are dealing with.

In this role you will.
• Proactively scope the technical solution required to address customer requirements, assesses customers’ met and unmet needs, and recommends solutions that optimize value for both the customer and Thunes.
• Coordinates closely with sales, sales support, and delivery teams to align solution design with customers’ business requirements
• Secure from customer technical resource commitments needed to ensure a deal’s “technical close.”
• Lead and drive the partner integration from the analysis phase though the integration design until go live and post-delivery monitoring
• Support existing partners that are already integrated to the platform with their daily challenges and expansion plans
• Provide solutions and contribute to proof of concepts outside of the box for some special projects
• Drive improvements for internal monitoring, reporting and operational tools and processes
• Provides training to the sales team in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills

To stand out you will:
• Be customer facing – you will have a close relationship with our partners and business development teams to expand our coverage and services
• Work closely with different internal teams to understand and support operational processes and new solutions
• Always keep a solution mindset and look for improvements that you can bring to the organization
• Work with an agile and expanding team, offering mentoring, training and possibly management to junior members
• Participate in continuous integration, managing updates from concept to deployment
• Opportunistically pursues additional business development opportunities within customer firms

Skills & Qualifications:
• Prior & proven min. ~3 years of experience in a technical project management (API / Integrations) or solutions delivery role with external stakeholders
• Experience in a B2B company supporting partners on a technical solution or service
• Experience working and strong interest in the Fintech and/or Payment Industry and market innovations
• Experience working and integrating with APIs over IP (REST, Json XML, Web Services, …)
• Experience working in an Agile environment – Jira management is a plus
• Demonstrate motivation to learn new skills and technologies
• Ability to work effectively, multi-task, agile and take responsibility in challenging situations
• Strong customer focused and result oriented mindset
• Independent and proactive - willing to get things done
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills, be creative, friendly and solution-oriented with customers and colleagues
• Fluency in English, other European or African languages are a plus.

Sound like you? Apply now

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager - Google Solutions - 9 months
jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Our client is one of the Big Five companies in the American information technology industry that specialises in Internet-related services and products, which include online advertising technologies, a search engine, cloud computing, software, and hardware.

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

Challenge
• Anticipate, identify, and recommend creative ways to improve on solutions to defined problems via evaluation and analysis of data and business needs.
• Troubleshoot commonly escalated issues or triage when required.

Influence
• Work within one or more teams to communicate project knowledge and priorities, providing guidance to more junior team members.
• Identify key stakeholders internally and externally to build networks and contribute to cross-team collaborations and training.
• As needed, act as a point of contact in TVC engagements (e.g., escalation).
• Communicate effectively with internal teams.
• Coordinate timelines, goals, and objectives for assigned... component(s) of a client/stakeholder project.
• Identify and recommend creative ways to leverage and/or enhance existing processes and/or tools through optimisation.

Expertise
• Demonstrate full-working knowledge of areas of expertise, and an understanding of related areas of the Google organisation, including understanding of technologies, process impacts, and upstream/downstream processes and functions.
• Exercise working knowledge of translating commercial business models/needs into solutions.

Responsibilities under the direction of Google Manager

Driving efficiencies
• Support updating of existing solution content or create repeatable content (e.g., best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, sample code) and ensure effective documentation of repeatable solutions.
• Contribute to delivery of business efficiency plans (BEP), recognises current inefficiencies and proposes options.

Partner strategy for solutions
• Help generate partner insights and participate in business reviews with partners to formulate partner strategies, with minimal guidance. Help provide reactive consultation to partners to identify new business opportunities. Contribute to the execution of partner strategies to adopt Google technologies.

Project management
• Manage project planning, status reporting, time-line estimation, issue tracking, meeting facilitation, and project documentation.
• Propose next steps and roadblock solutions and anticipate questions and challenges.

Solution delivery
• Execute solutions, with occasional support from peers/community, based on user/partner/client business objectives and technical requirements that have been previously defined, developed, and approved.

Solution delivery improvement

• Help leverage, customise, or develop technical or nontechnical solutions based on defined user/partner/client business objectives that are compliant with legal, with minimal guidance.

Solution strategy
• Support defining of long-term solution strategies in collaboration with cross-functional teams and influence the direction and priority of technical product features and/or the solution with minimal guidance.

Customer conversations

Google solutions
• Ability to articulate how customers and partners can use Google products, services, and solutions to identify needs, solve problems, and drive growth.

Industry knowledge

Opportunity and pipeline management
• Ability to discover opportunities to deliver expanded customer value by effectively managing the pipeline throughout the entire sales/customer lifecycle.

Problem-solving
• Ability to use critical thinking and diverse data to solve problems, drive decision-making, and make improvements.

Project management
• Knowledge of project planning methodology, deployment planning process, and sequence. This includes the ability to understand, or to manage smaller parts or phases of a bigger project, or an understanding of how to translate capacity demand into a low-level production system project plan.

• Ability to interact confidently, clearly, and respectfully with others, especially senior leaders of the organisation, to present/defend/clarify concerns or issues regarding an existing project, program or solution. Systems thinking

Technical acumen
• Ability to quickly learn the general concepts and principles in a statistical and mathematical domain, solve or analyse issues or provide useful insights, and demonstrate interest and curiosity in acquiring knowledge across similar domains.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Industrial Automation
jobs_results.description:
The future is what we make it.

When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future. That means changing the way we fly, fueling jets in an eco-friendly way, keeping buildings smart and safe and even making it possible to breathe on Mars.

Working at Honeywell isn’t just about developing cool things. That’s why all our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields and industries.

Are you ready to help us make the future?

We are currently looking for a Senior Program Management Specialist to join Industry Automation our team! The purpose of this position is to execute LSS Projects in Southern Europe region and based in Spain to deliver best in class solutions to meet customer expectations and within estimated financial performance. Lead the skills development, information sharing and project management discipline necessary to the deliver Projects in a... timely manner at planned gross margins or higher in the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Overall responsibility for managing Projects in Southern region from opportunity development stage to delivering the project successfully to customer.

· Ensures on time delivery of projects, within scope with zero or positive deviation.

· Maintains customer's satisfaction at acceptable levels and promptly resolves customer issues.

· Ownership for Projects financial performance. Monitors financial performance monthly and reviews estimates versus actuals to continuously improve Projects operational metrics.

· Effectively leads the implementation of productivity enhancing process changes related to project delivery.

· Responsible for driving costs down to be competitive in the marketplace.

· Controls cost and maximize productivity through the implementation of effective methods and standard processes.

· Drive Remote Migration Services for all Migration projects.

· Enhance utilization of GMSC for all Migration projects

· Ensures the availability of tools, equipment, and materials required while maintaining and controlling inventory levels. Ensures projects are resourced properly.

· Participate in estimate review process prior to jobs being quoted to ensure labor estimates are correct and that the work is achievable from a technical perspective. Ensure that subcontracts, where applicable, are complete and documented.

· Participate in material SIOP call with factory planners to provide forecast for Backlog and Front log project order demand to factory

REQUIREMENTS:

· BS degree or equivalent technical or management experience required.

· Thorough knowledge of handling LSS Projects field operations and financial processes

· The ability to demonstrate energy and determination to achieve results and improvement by overcoming obstacles, remaining effective despite setbacks, and challenging current thinking

· The ability to engage employees by providing relevant information in a timely manner using clear and compelling messages and by listening to and valuing input from employees.

· The ability to understand the implications and assess the appropriate degree of acceptable risk and take actions to minimize risk.

WE OFFER:

· A challenging international work environment.

· A competitive salary package with a variety of fringe benefits.

· Career development possibilities.

If this is your dream role, then we'd love to hear from you!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
Additional Information
• JOB ID: HRD223809
• Category: Business Management
• Location: Floors G, 1-3, LA CALLE MARÍA DE PORTUGAL,Madrid,MADRID,28050,Spain
• Exempt
•

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager - Floating Offshore Wind
jobs_results.description:
Technical Project Manager - Floating Offshore Wind

Are you ready to take your career to the next level in the renewable energy sector? Our client is currently seeking a talented Technical Project Manager with expertise in Floating Front End Engineering Design (FEED) to join othier team.

Position: Technical Project Manager - Floating

Location: Barcelona, Spain

About the Role: As a Technical Project Manager specializing in Floating FEED, you will play a pivotal role in leading and managing engineering design projects from concept to FEED completion. Your responsibilities will include coordinating multidisciplinary teams, ensuring project milestones are met, and delivering high-quality engineering solutions within budget and schedule constraints. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that drive innovation in the renewable energy industry.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage Floating FEED projects, ensuring adherence to project scope, schedule, and... budget.
• Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to gather project requirements and specifications.
• Oversee the development of engineering deliverables, including technical drawings, specifications, and reports.
• Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring timely resolution of issues to maintain project momentum.
• Monitor project progress and performance metrics, providing regular updates to stakeholders.
• Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, promoting teamwork and knowledge sharing among project team members.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field; Master's degree preferred.
• Proven experience in project management, specifically in Floating FEED projects within the renewable energy sector.
• Strong technical background in structural engineering, offshore engineering, or related disciplines.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.
• Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a track record of successfully leading multidisciplinary teams.
• Proficiency in project management tools and software.

Why Join our Client?
• Opportunity to work on innovative projects that contribute to the advancement of renewable energy technologies.
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.
• Competitive compensation package with comprehensive benefits.
